Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes

C-1277
Claimant:
Jeremy Bailey

2024-11-28
Claim opened after the insured reported a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes. The driver is named on the
policy, and nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-12-04
Photos from the scene, witness statements, and the other driver's account all describe the collision the same way.
The other vehicle moved into the insured's lane as the insured was merging.
2025-01-20
The damage to the right side of the insured vehicle lines up with the impact described, and there is no record of
earlier damage to that vehicle.
2025-05-10
The claimant reports a knee injury and is represented by counsel. Counsel has asked that all contact be routed
through their office.
2025-05-18
Police and witnesses confirm the claimant was riding in the insured vehicle at the time. The initial medical report
describes a knee injury that fits the kind and force of the collision well.
2025-05-21
No prior injury to the same knee appears in the records obtained so far. The claimant's account in the recorded
statement and the later interview is consistent, although some small details were added in the later interview without
changing the core account.
2025-06-20
Treatment has continued to expand well beyond what this type of knee injury usually requires, with more visits and
new services added month after month. An independent medical review has been requested to assess the treatment
plan.
2025-07-02
The file is under review pending the independent medical review and receipt of the remaining treatment records. The
accident mechanics, vehicle damage, and occupant information are all consistent with the calim as reported.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
